title: One bit of possibility
description: A single pale disc turns in a field of black mechanical dots.
camera: 100mm macro. Locked-off. Wait for one disc to pivot.
sound: Silence, then one dry mechanical tick.
voiceover: What makes a body feel alive?
transition: A second click becomes the beginning of the wave.

title: A signal acquires weight
description: A sparse wave travels across a physical flip-dot board.
camera: Tripod locked. Random disc flips; no camera or focus movement.
sound: Individual ticks gather into a short, uneven sequence.
transition: Match the circular discs to a physical rotary control.

title: Something to turn
description: A rotary encoder sits beside a tiny physical display.
camera: Tripod locked. Fixed focus; only three display discs flip.
sound: A single detent click, a low electrical room tone.
transition: Hold a beat of black before revealing the material.

title: The world answers back
description: A dark diaphragm bends under an unseen force.
camera: Fixed macro. A narrow reflection reveals a small deformation.
sound: A soft material creak. Let the room tone drop away.
voiceover: An interface meets resistance. What should it understand?
transition: Match the reflected line into the diffused signal.

title: A response, almost
description: A sparse response appears in a physical flip-dot grid.
camera: Tripod locked. Four mechanical discs flip; no glass or focus pull.
sound: Two isolated ticks with space between them.
transition: The unresolved dots cut to a legible physical board.

title: The invitation arrives
description: A suspended mechanical display resolves the date and time.
camera: Straight-on static frame. Flip the date first, then the time.
sound: Two restrained bursts of disc clicks. End in silence.
transition: Hold the date and title. No visual fade until the details are readable.
